imagery.vintage: not independently provided by the tile response
imagery.method: Independent Leaflet captures centered at zoom 19; visible building, parking, driveway and apron extents estimated against the screenshot scale.

roads.assessment: Road/service-drive centerlines were inspected alongside imagery as plausibility evidence; they do not verify station gates or apparatus entrances.

limits: No official station parcel or building footprint was used.
Image-based fit dimensions and modeled spawn points are estimates, not surveyed measurements.
No apparatus door, gate, or emergency access route was independently verified.
Original source coordinates remain in each base record.

roadConnectionChecks.method: Shared base-locations.js area/segment intersection semantics plus OSM segment distance and exact-coordinate node graph reachability from the nearest road geometry.

connectedFeaturePath: estimated station-side driveway to mapped roadway
results.gapNote: The OSM pack does not encode this station driveway; imagery shows the apparent throat. Spawn-to-road connection is therefore image-estimated, not network-verified.

roadConnectionChecks.caveat: These checks establish modeled geometric/network plausibility only. They do not prove vehicle collision behavior, driveway/gate access, permitted turns, or operational station entrances. Ajax runtime dispatch is not fully enabled in this checkout, so an in-game drive-out could not be exercised.

runtimeChecks.method: Called PTBO_ROAD_COLLISION.beginStationExit at each modeled spawn, advanced in 1.5 m steps with resolveMovement toward nearest road projection, and required an unblocked path ending on a drivable point within 2.5 m of that road point.
runtimeChecks.limits: This directly exercised the runtime collision movement API from each configured spawn to its nearest mapped drivable road point. It did not simulate sustained vehicle acceleration or validate an actual station gate/garage door.
